blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust applied to Agri-Food Processing. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

items: Quality grading by inspectors; variance and throughput loss.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Provenance, Traceability & Supply Chain Trust, Blockchain Analytics & Regulatory Compliance, Smart Contract Engineering & Audit from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Intake grading, Process yield analytics, Lot traceability) on Dataq Ledger and Dataq Sentinel. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food safety (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Credentials users carry: portable, privacy-preserving verification for workforce and customers.
On-chain transparency, operationalized: analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls.
Permissioned networks for multi-party truth: governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
EUDR-grade custody with regulator interface (claims verified)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: geolocation-anchored plots, custody events and regulator interfaces (due-diligence evidence produced continuously). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
